\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 170-173 — a first pass}

\label{lesson:TA-R178-first-pass-words-from-chapters-170-173}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for free of charge and ripe.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item an allergy, an infection, a scar, diarrhoea, the brain
  \item often, sometimes, always, never, a delay
  \item the future, tonight, suddenly, in advance, a calendar
  \item a kitchen, a bathroom, a bedroom, a toilet, a window
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
An allergy? (\textbf{\ta{ஒவ்வாமை}}, \emph{ovvāmai}.) An infection? (\textbf{\ta{தொற்று}}, \emph{toṟṟu}.) A scar? (\textbf{\ta{தழும்பு}}, \emph{taḻumpu}.) Diarrhoea? (\textbf{\ta{வயிற்றுப்போக்கு}}, \emph{vayiṟṟuppōkku}.) The brain? (\textbf{\ta{மூளை}}, \emph{mūḷai}.) Often? (\textbf{\ta{அடிக்கடி}}, \emph{aṭikkaṭi}.) Sometimes? (\textbf{\ta{சில} \ta{நேரங்களில்}}, \emph{cila nēraṅkaḷil}.) Always? (\textbf{\ta{எப்போதும்}}, \emph{eppōtum}.) Never? (\textbf{\ta{ஒருபோதும்}}, \emph{orupōtum}.) A delay? (\textbf{\ta{தாமதம்}}, \emph{tāmatam}.) The future? (\textbf{\ta{எதிர்காலம்}}, \emph{etirkālam}.) Tonight? (\textbf{\ta{இன்றிரவு}}, \emph{iṉṟiravu}.) Suddenly? (\textbf{\ta{திடீரென்று}}, \emph{tiṭīreṉṟu}.) In advance? (\textbf{\ta{முன்கூட்டியே}}, \emph{muṉkūṭṭiyē}.) A calendar? (\textbf{\ta{நாட்காட்டி}}, \emph{nāṭkāṭṭi}.) A kitchen? (\textbf{\ta{சமையலறை}}, \emph{camaiyalaṟai}.) A bathroom? (\textbf{\ta{குளியலறை}}, \emph{kuḷiyalaṟai}.) A bedroom? (\textbf{\ta{படுக்கையறை}}, \emph{paṭukkaiyaṟai}.) A toilet? (\textbf{\ta{கழிப்பறை}}, \emph{kaḻippaṟai}.) A window? (\textbf{\ta{சன்னல்}}, \emph{caṉṉal}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 174-178 — a second pass}

\label{lesson:TA-R178-second-pass-words-from-chapters-174-178}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a boat and a bicycle.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a boat, a bicycle, a car, an auto-rickshaw, a passenger
  \item a desert, a cave, a stream, a farm, a zoo
  \item however, even though, moreover, for example, otherwise
  \item a result, a problem, a solution, a purpose, an experience
  \item tasty, cheap, expensive, free of charge, ripe
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A boat? (\textbf{\ta{படகு}}, \emph{paṭaku}.) A bicycle? (\textbf{\ta{மிதிவண்டி}}, \emph{mitivaṇṭi}.) A car? (\textbf{\ta{கார்}}, \emph{kār}.) An auto-rickshaw? (\textbf{\ta{ஆட்டோ}}, \emph{āṭṭō}.) A passenger? (\textbf{\ta{பயணி}}, \emph{payaṇi}.) A desert? (\textbf{\ta{பாலைவனம்}}, \emph{pālaivaṉam}.) A cave? (\textbf{\ta{குகை}}, \emph{kukai}.) A stream? (\textbf{\ta{ஓடை}}, \emph{ōṭai}.) A farm? (\textbf{\ta{பண்ணை}}, \emph{paṇṇai}.) A zoo? (\textbf{\ta{மிருகக்காட்சிசாலை}}, \emph{mirukakkāṭcicālai}.) However? (\textbf{\ta{ஆனாலும்}}, \emph{āṉālum}.) Even though? (\textbf{\ta{இருந்தாலும்}}, \emph{iruntālum}.) Moreover? (\textbf{\ta{மேலும்}}, \emph{mēlum}.) For example? (\textbf{\ta{உதாரணமாக}}, \emph{utāraṇamāka}.) Otherwise? (\textbf{\ta{இல்லாவிட்டால்}}, \emph{illāviṭṭāl}.) A result? (\textbf{\ta{விளைவு}}, \emph{viḷaivu}.) A problem? (\textbf{\ta{பிரச்சினை}}, \emph{piracciṉai}.) A solution? (\textbf{\ta{தீர்வு}}, \emph{tīrvu}.) A purpose? (\textbf{\ta{நோக்கம்}}, \emph{nōkkam}.) An experience? (\textbf{\ta{அனுபவம்}}, \emph{aṉupavam}.) Tasty? (\textbf{\ta{சுவையான}}, \emph{cuvaiyāṉa}.) Cheap? (\textbf{\ta{மலிவான}}, \emph{malivāṉa}.) Expensive? (\textbf{\ta{விலையுயர்ந்த}}, \emph{vilaiyuyarnta}.) Free of charge? (\textbf{\ta{இலவசம்}}, \emph{ilavacam}.) Ripe? (\textbf{\ta{பழுத்த}}, \emph{paḻutta}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
